claims.disproof_condition: 條件：京東方一手寫出客戶端晶片級電性測試失敗、送樣客戶退出，或 2027 年中前未達到量產投資決策條件。核查頻率：每季（巨潮資訊網 IR 記錄表、季報）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 加註，重讀玻璃芯這一層的供給側時鐘。
claims.statement: BOE investor-relations record 2026-048 (visit on 2026-10-15, disclosed 2026-10-16): the pilot line has fully automated equipment connection; 24-layer (11-2-11) glass-core package substrates larger than 100x100 mm have been produced and sampled, and have passed Pre-con, TCB 1000 cycles, UHAST, BHAST, HTSL and LTSL reliability standard tests. Per BOE's 2026-09-22 results briefing these tests were run in BOE's own fab; chip-level electrical tests with customers were not yet complete, and the chairman targets meeting mass-production investment-decision conditions (customer volume and yield) in 1H 2027 (aiming for Q1). Developer self-statement; customers not named.
